evidence_items.explanation: The February–March 2025 sample documents low-quality AI content in educational video results. The authors also describe it as not especially prevalent in this sample, so this supports occurrence rather than web-wide deterioration.

NewsGuard identifies AI-enabled false narratives targeting France and measures their cumulative dissemination through March 2025. This supports mass dissemination; views are not unique viewers or proof of belief.

evidence_items.locator: Key findings, overall identity fraud rate
evidence_items.explanation: This cautions against treating increased sophistication as increased incidence. The vendor's identity-fraud rate fell from 2024 but remained above 2023; neither comparison alone settles the broader cyberscam claim.

evidence_items.locator: Second paragraph of the press release
evidence_items.explanation: Total internet-crime complaints increased, but that category is broader than scams. The release separately identifies AI-related complaints without a comparable earlier AI series, so it does not establish increasing AI-enabled scam incidence.
